supersedes: Nothing. COVID-QUAR-TAIL-01 (measured 6fa5e3bc, pure readout of the committed covid_theta_refit_01 dp_theta_8p50 payloads) factorized the late tail at right-sized truth into late ignition x an under-damped confinement declaration, and declared this discriminating probe: reduced-exempt confinement compositions on the verbatim boxed_s1s2 theta=3.162e8 operating point. CREW-WINDOW-02 measured the dose-response at the clause-leg thetas (during-mass median 301 @7.9e6 FRAC_25, 336 ZONE_NARROW vs band [150,350]; realized exempt ~0.24-0.32). Correction folded in from the committed 8p50 cells: boxed_s1s2 already runs SOP-017-MESSBOX (the 11-zone essential exempt list + boxed crew meals) and illness pre-confines ~72% of crew before the order fires - realized_exempt_share reads 0.27-0.31 at activation, ~0.02 by day 34. The probe therefore discriminates crew-service-fed vs cabin-resident tail carriage on top of the boxed baseline: the frozen dual prediction stands (during-window mass into [150,350] AND confirmed-per-infection capture >= 0.80), and a null/marginal response names the cabin-resident droplet loop as the carrier.
description: QUAR-TAIL-SEAM-01: seed-paired arm probe on the verbatim boxed_s1s2 replay at the one right-sized-theta DP operating point - theta 3.162e8 x 4 arms x 20 seeds = 80 declared-replay cells on the diamond_princess_2020 contract (infection_age_days 6.8, imports 1, dwell_weighted, quarantine days 16-30). Every cell runs base_overrides (the boxed_s1s2 resolved configuration) with only the arm's declared delta on top. Arms: D0_declared (boxed_s1s2 verbatim; pairing base + drift witness vs the committed 8p50 cells), MB_DUTY (boxed + crew_duty_exclusion armed - the VSP 2018 OM 4.4.1.1.1 symptomatic-removal clause boxed_s1s2 ships disabled), FRAQMB (boxed with the 11-zone exempt lottery replaced by the exact-quarter fraction draw via SOP-017-QUARTERMB), FRAQMB_DUTY (FRAQMB + crew_duty_exclusion). All non-D0 arms are non-scoring discriminating probes.
prerequisites: COVID-QUAR-TAIL-01 measured (6fa5e3bc): at theta=3.162e8 the during/after-quarantine tail factorizes into late ignition (before-median 90 vs 1651-2240 on record-timed cells) x an under-damped confinement declaration (post-activation incidence flat ~R=1 through day 30; cabin zone 72%, droplet 56% + service_to_host 32% + caregiver 11%; crew carry 55% of during-window infections). crew_duty_exclusion resolved enabled:false on the committed cells.
COVID-CAPTURE-01 measured (7b34405d): pooled capture 0.723 / median 0.525 on the same cells; record-timed cells confirm 0.911-0.930 as declared. Capture is a readout of incidence timing.

CREW-WINDOW-02 measured (2df542ff, 240/240): during-mass monotone in realized exempt share; FRAC_25 (realized 0.242) -> during median 301 and ZONE_NARROW (0.271 realized) -> 336 @7.9e6, both inside the record-informed band [150,350]; boxed_s1s2's realized exempt share at activation reads 0.27-0.31 at 8p50 (illness pre-confinement), not the clause-leg's ~0.96-0.99.

Arm grammar verified: arm overrides may compose scheduled_protocol_id + crew_duty_exclusion (covid_boarding_screen ARM_OVERRIDE_KEYS); SOP-017-QUARTERMB ships in protocols.json from this leg (MESSBOX with exempt_fraction in place of the zone list); crew_duty_exclusion ships enabled:false with a resolved echo block and is a standing policy, not a day-16 intervention.
thetas_note: The single right-sized operating point - verbatim the covid_theta_refit_01 dp_theta_8p50 block theta - where CAPTURE-01 and QUAR-TAIL-01 were measured. Every arm pairs seed-for-seed against the committed 8p50 cells AND the in-design D0 row.
infection_age_note: Verbatim replay contract; a null axis on explicit seeds (COVID-SEED-GEOM-01).
seeds_note: The matched 20-seed set 20200205-20200224 - identical to THETA-REFIT-01/CW-01/CW-02 so every arm row pairs seed-for-seed against the committed dp_theta_8p50 cells (takeoff-gated to the 16 takeoff seeds for timing comparisons).
base_overrides_note: The boxed_s1s2 resolved configuration - verbatim the covid_theta_refit_01 base block (SOP-017-MESSBOX: 11-zone essential exempt list + boxed crew meals; section-bound steward service cabins [10,15] contact_factor_to_host [0.005,0.02]; retest tiers + day-34 crew wave) - applied to every cell BEFORE the arm's own overrides so each arm is a single declared delta on the committed replay. The cell worker composes base under arm (arm keys win).

arms.note: boxed_s1s2 verbatim - SOP-017-MESSBOX days 16-30 (11-zone essential exempt list + boxed crew meals), section steward service, retest tiers + crew wave, crew_duty_exclusion disabled. First arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar. Doubles as the pairing base and as the drift witness against the committed dp_theta_8p50 cells.

boxed_s1s2 plus the crew_duty_exclusion gate armed - the CW-01 CREWDUTY mechanism (VSP 2018 OM 4.4.1.1.1: symptomatic working crew removed to confinement) on top of the committed MESSBOX exempt structure. The record's medical pulled infectious crew; this is the record-warding single-lever arm. Standing policy: it binds symptomatic crew before the window too, so before-window movement on DUTY arms is an expected reported effect, not a violation. Canary arm. Declared Grade C; non-scoring.

boxed_s1s2 with SOP-017-QUARTERMB in place of MESSBOX - boxed crew meals kept, the 11-zone exempt lottery replaced by the sticky exact-count fraction draw (exempt_fraction crew_general 0.25 = 261 of 1045). The headcount reading of 'skeleton crew' vs the baseline's zone-essential reading, isolating the exempt-share lever alone (symptomatic removal still off). Declared Grade C; non-scoring.

FRAQMB plus crew_duty_exclusion armed - the full record-warding composition: quarter headcount + boxed meals + symptomatic removal. Same standing-policy caveat as MB_DUTY. Declared Grade C; non-scoring.

cells_note: 1 theta x 4 arms x 20 seeds = 80 declared-replay cells (~30 min each on the campaign image). Cell order arm x seed; canary = MB_DUTY (20 seeds) - the single-lever record-warding arm, reads the duty-exclusion echo on the committed replay structure - read out and reported before the remaining 60 submit per the campaign-preflight gate.

admissibility.note: FROZEN before any cell exists. The dual prediction is declared in COVID-QUAR-TAIL-01 and frozen here verbatim: an arm carrying the reduced-exempt / symptomatic-removal composition lands BOTH the record-informed during-window band AND a capture rise toward the record's ~0.85. Every non-D0 arm is a discriminating probe, never a score; whichever lands is a magnitude to source afterward.

conditional_trajectory_clause.criterion: Verbatim from the v11 lineage: among takeoff seeds (recorded_onsets >= 10), the q05-q95 interval of recorded_onsets contains 197 AND the takeoff-seed median before_share is within 0.10 of 0.173; scored only when the row has >= 5 takeoff seeds, else 'insufficient takeoff mass'.
conditional_trajectory_clause.note: Scored on the D0_declared rows only - every other arm is exempt by construction; arm rows report the same fields as non-scoring context.

record_informed_during_band.criterion: Takeoff-conditional median infections_during_window (days 16-30) inside [150, 350] on the arm row; before-window mass (infections_before_quarantine) seed-paired unmoved vs the in-design D0 row on non-DUTY arms (on DUTY arms a nonzero before-delta is the standing policy's expected pre-window effect - reported, not a violation).
record_informed_during_band.source: NIID during-quarantine dated mass scaled to infections (covid_believability_map_v1.md F8/F11 lineage)

capture_rise.criterion: Takeoff-conditional median confirmed/infections (lab_confirmed / infections_total, takeoff seeds only) >= 0.80 on the arm row - the 'toward ~0.85' direction from COVID-QUAR-TAIL-01; committed D0 cells read pooled 0.723 / median 0.525. The full CAPTURE-01 decomposition (drain classes, dpi histograms) is a post-hoc readout on the synced cells, not part of the frozen verdict; funnel_echo is armed on every cell so the decomposition resolves.
capture_rise.source: Record confirmed-per-infection ~0.85 (712/840); CAPTURE-01 measurement baseline at 6fa5e3bc.

verdict_grammar.SEAM-LANDED: during median inside [150,350] AND capture median >= 0.80 AND before mass seed-paired unmoved (on DUTY arms the before-delta is the expected standing-policy effect and is reported, not scored) - the confinement-dose lever resolves the timing/capture couple at right-sized truth. Rows under 5 takeoff cells report INSUFFICIENT-TAKEOFF-MASS, never a band verdict on mixed cohorts.
verdict_grammar.HALF-LANDED-MASS: during median inside [150,350] but capture median < 0.80 - the tail was damped but the capture residual is not the confined loop; report the residual and the CAPTURE-01 drain decomposition on the arm.
verdict_grammar.UNDER-DAMPED: during median moves toward but stays above the band; report residual + crew share + band-side miss.
verdict_grammar.OVER-DAMPED: during median below the band - joins ALLHANDS on the too-strong side; the bracket narrows but no candidate conforms.
verdict_grammar.UNMOVED: seed-paired delta inside RNG-reorder noise - the arm never reached the channel; audit the crew_window realized-share echo and the crew_duty_exclusion resolved block first (a DUTY arm with excluded_hosts 0, or a FRAQMB arm with no exempt_fraction_drawn echo, is a mechanism-didn't-fire witness).

admissibility.age_witness: infections_by_age_band / during_window_by_age_band / dated_onsets_by_age_band read against the NIID confirmed-by-decade curve as SHAPE WITNESS only - the barred training set is never a fit target.
audit_invariants: quarantine_witness.window_days == [16,30] and activated true on every cell
quarantine_witness.exempt_classes == shipped four crew classes on EVERY arm (the modifiers restrict within the exempt set; the declared class list is unchanged)
index_onset_day == -1.0 and index_shedding_at_day0 true on every cell

propensity_draw.units_drawn > 0; delivery.caregiver.mode resolves on; presentation_draw_mode == 'once_per_course'; hand_reservoir_mode == 'hygiene_cycle'; delivery echo droplet_field_split matches shipped values on every arm
crew_window block on every cell: total_crew == 1045; confined_crew_count + working_crew_count == total_crew at activation and at end

crew_window.exempt_work_zones echoes the declared 11-zone MESSBOX list verbatim on D0_declared/MB_DUTY cells (null on FRAQMB cells); crew_window.exempt_fraction_drawn == {crew_general: 261} exactly on FRAQMB/FRAQMB_DUTY cells keyed by SOP-017-QUARTERMB

crew_window.realized_exempt_share strictly in (0,1) on every cell (0 or 1 means the gate never fired); D0 cells read ~0.27-0.31 at activation on the committed realization - illness pre-confinement is expected, not a violation

crew_duty_exclusion.resolved.enabled == true on MB_DUTY/FRAQMB_DUTY cells and false on D0_declared/FRAQMB; excluded_hosts > 0 reported on DUTY arms (a zero is a mechanism-didn't-fire witness, not a silent pass)
crew_window.service_deliveries recorded on every cell; ~zero on a confining arm is a reported starvation witness, not a silent zero
funnel_hosts present on every cell (funnel_echo armed): the CAPTURE-01 decomposition requires host histories + specimen log; an empty funnel on a completed cell is a mechanism-didn't-fire witness

diagnostics.paired_vs_in_design_d0: Each arm row pairs seed-for-seed with its in-design D0_declared row: delta infections_during_window, delta during_window_by_role (crew and passenger separately), delta during_window_by_age_band, delta infections_before_quarantine (expected ~0 on non-DUTY arms; on DUTY arms the standing policy may legitimately remove symptomatic crew pre-window - reported as the policy effect), delta recorded_onsets/before_share, delta lab_confirmed/infections_total, and the during-window crew share vs the record's ~0.29 (whole-voyage confirmed basis - direction, not magnitude).
diagnostics.paired_vs_committed_8p50: Each D0_declared row pairs seed-for-seed against the committed covid_theta_refit_01 dp_theta_8p50 cells at 7b34405d+ (S3 campaign/covid_theta_refit_01/dp_theta_8p50/) restricted to the 16 committed takeoff seeds - the armed-tree drift witness since the refit ran, and the direct capture-vs-phase comparison.
diagnostics.confined_passenger_bound: confined_passenger_infections_during_quarantine reported vs the >=52 record lower bound; recorded but not scored here.
diagnostics.realized_share: crew_window.working_crew_by_posted_zone and realized_exempt_share vs the lottery expectation (MESSBOX 11/34 ~ 0.324; QUARTERMB exact-count 261/1045 = 0.25 before illness confinement); a material departure is reported with the realized distribution.
diagnostics.capture_decomposition: CAPTURE-01's readout (tools/covid_capture_rate_readout.py) re-run on the synced arm cells post-hoc: pooled/median capture, drain classes, dpi-at-swab histograms - verifies whether a capture rise lands through the specimen machinery as expected. funnel_echo is armed on this design so host histories + the specimen log are present on every cell.

execution.platform: AWS Batch via campaigns/covid/quar_tail_01/ through scripts/campaign (the campaigns/ grammar) - 4 blocks (arm) x 20 seeds; jobdef picard-covid-quar-tail-01, image covid-quar-tail-01, S3 prefix campaign/covid_quar_tail_01/, queue picard-analysis-queue (On-Demand; Fargate fallback picard-analysis-fargate-queue). Mega cells on Batch only.
execution.canary: Per the campaign-preflight gate: local smoke proving each arm reaches the confinement + duty-exclusion paths on the boxed base (crew_duty_exclusion resolved.enabled true on DUTY arms; exempt_fraction_drawn 261 on FRAQMB arms; the MESSBOX zone list echoed on D0/MB_DUTY), dry-run count = 80, pinned image digest + jobdef revision, manifest in S3, then the 20-seed MB_DUTY canary read out and reported before the remaining 60 cells submit.
execution.stop_rules: Report immediately if any audit invariant fails; a cell's realized exempt share departs materially from its declared draw; a DUTY arm's excluded_hosts is zero; any arm lands the dual prediction (SEAM-LANDED); service_deliveries collapses on a confining arm; a completed cell carries an empty funnel_hosts; or child failure rate exceeds 5%.

rejected_alternatives.zone_narrow_arm: DROPPED AS REDUNDANT: boxed_s1s2 already runs SOP-017-MESSBOX - the 11-zone essential exempt list IS the baseline. A plain SOP-017-NARROW arm would additionally strip boxed crew meals, confounding the share lever with the mess lever.
rejected_alternatives.exempt_classes_subset: MEASURED-DEGENERATE (CW-01): the DP hull instantiates only passenger_general + crew_general; class-subset exemptions confine the identical whole crew (ALLHANDS-equivalent).
rejected_alternatives.zone_wide_arm: DROPPED: ZONE_WIDE (19 zones incl. dining, ~0.56 realized) was CW-02's furthest interior point at 504 during-mass @7.9e6 - still UNDER-ATTENUATED on the wide side; the fractional alternative covers the headcount reading at the seam's ~0.25 point.
rejected_alternatives.duty_exclusion_alone_on_plain_sop: DROPPED: CW-01 measured CREWDUTY @7.9e6 nearly neutral on its own (758 vs D0 739) - on the boxed base MB_DUTY is the standing-policy lever on the realized working set; composing it on FRAQMB keeps the factorial interpretable.
rejected_alternatives.tuned_scalar: REJECTED: no arm tunes a constant to the band or the capture target. Zone lists and fractions are record-wording readings; duty exclusion is a verbatim VSP clause.
